assumptions: b and y ions explain the spectrum; peaks match within the tolerance given.
limits: A score, not a probability: a q-value needs target_decoy_qvalues over a whole set.
Only b and y series are scored.
bio.jane/contract.question: How well does this MS/MS spectrum match this peptide, by X!Tandem HyperScore?

description: Score how well an MS/MS spectrum matches a peptide with the X!Tandem HyperScore (validated against OpenMS): b and y ions are generated for the peptide, matched to the observed peaks within a tolerance, and scored as ln(1 + dot product) + ln(matched b!) + ln(matched y!).

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

intensity.description: observed peak intensities, one per m/z.

peptide.description: candidate peptide, one-letter residues with optional ProForma tags (a signed mass, a Unimod name, or UNIMOD:accession).

precursorCharge.description: precursor charge; fragments are generated at charges 1 to max(1, charge - 1).

name: score_spectrum

detail.description: matched b and y ion counts, mean match error, theoretical peak count

matches.description: one row per matched ion: ion name, theoretical and observed m/z, intensity, error in the tolerance unit

score.description: HyperScore (natural log scale; higher is a better match)
